name: Pulsation-Synchronized Catalytic Contact-Time Lock
freeze_attempt_R277: 4 of 8 design parameters FROZEN (engineering). 4 of 8 BLOCKED on biology (enzyme identity, immobilization chemistry, catalytic kinetics, CSF stability). Cannot promote to PROTOTYPE_READY without 6-12 months of enzyme engineering work. See P-04_FREEZE/freeze_status.json.

1_executive_technology_brief.what_it_does: Dynamically modulates CSF flow through an enzymatic membrane to synchronize catalytic contact time with cardiac/CSF pulsation cycles, maximizing protein clearance efficiency while maintaining therapeutic drainage.
1_executive_technology_brief.why_it_matters: Enables dual-function shunt: CSF drainage + amyloid/tau clearance. >60% of NPH patients have Alzheimer's comorbidity.
1_executive_technology_brief.technical_differentiator: Pulsation-synchronized flow modulation — the flow controller locks contact time to the patient's physiological pulsation, not to a fixed flow rate.
1_executive_technology_brief.honest_disclosure_R277: The 'enzyme cocktail' (neprilysin + BACE2 + tau-kinase inhibitor) was a HYPOTHESIS, not a design. R277 freeze attempt revealed: (a) BACE2's role in Aβ reduction is contested in literature, (b) 'tau-kinase inhibitor enzyme' is chemically inconsistent (inhibitors are small molecules, not enzymes), (c) no published data on any enzyme immobilized in CSF-like conditions for >30 days. Single-enzyme path (likely NEP) is feasible in 6-12 months; triple-enzyme path is 12-18 months and may not be viable.

2_mechanism_dossier.causal_chain: Cardiac pulsation → CSF flow oscillation → flow controller modulates valve to extend contact time during low-flow phase → enzyme-substrate contact maximized → amyloid/tau clearance enhanced during drainage
2_mechanism_dossier.csf_abeta_concentration_critical_finding: CSF Aβ concentration (~0.1-0.2 nM) is FAR below NEP Km (~5-10 μM). The rate-limiting step is therefore Aβ TRANSPORT to the enzyme, not enzymatic catalysis. Membrane geometry (surface area, flow path length) dominates clearance, not enzyme loading. This REVERSES the original design intuition.

4_engineering_specification.enzymes: UNFROZEN. Original hypothesis (neprilysin + BACE2 + tau-kinase inhibitor) has three problems: (1) BACE2 role contested, (2) tau-kinase inhibitor is a small molecule not an enzyme, (3) chronic CSF stability of any candidate unknown. Recommended path: single-enzyme NEP. See P-04_FREEZE/01_enzyme_identity.json.
4_engineering_specification.immobilization: UNFROZEN. Depends on enzyme identity. Candidates: EDC/NHS covalent, sol-gel silica, PEG hydrogel. See P-04_FREEZE/02_immobilization_chemistry.json.
4_engineering_specification.kinetics: UNFROZEN. Literature values for NEP on Aβ: Km~5-10μM, kcat~10-50s^-1. Must be measured for our specific immobilized system. See P-04_FREEZE/03_catalytic_kinetics.json.
4_engineering_specification.csf_stability: UNFROZEN — biggest single unknown. No published data on enzyme stability in CSF >30 days. 5-year target may require replaceable cartridge design. See P-04_FREEZE/04_csf_stability.json.
4_engineering_specification.flow_range: FROZEN. Total 0.30 mL/min, per segment 0.05-0.20, pulsation 0.5-2 Hz 30-50% amplitude. See P-04_FREEZE/05_flow_range.json.
4_engineering_specification.contact_time_equation: FROZEN (form). tau = V/Q. Fractional clearance f = 1-exp(-k_cat_eff * E_surf * tau / (K_m_eff + [S])). Constants are placeholders until items 01-04 resolved. See P-04_FREEZE/06_contact_time_equation.json.
4_engineering_specification.safe_drainage_floor: FROZEN. Hard floor 0.10 mL/min. Fail-safe bypass to passive drainage if floor violated. See P-04_FREEZE/07_safe_drainage_floor.json.
4_engineering_specification.pulsation_sync_mechanism: FROZEN. Phase detector + synchronized valve modulation. Reuses P-01 hardware. See P-04_FREEZE/08_pulsation_sync_mechanism.json.

5_prototype_blueprint.v1_prototype_engineering_only: Bench-top flow cell with non-enzymatic membrane + pulsatile pump + variable orifice + flow sensor. Can validate pulsation sync mechanism (1.3-1.5x contact time enhancement) WITHOUT enzyme. Estimated $5-15K, 4-8 weeks. See P-04_FREEZE/EXTERNAL_VALIDATION_HANDOFF/frozen_protocol_engineering_only.json.
5_prototype_blueprint.v2_prototype_with_enzyme: Requires enzyme engineering program to complete first (items 01-04). Estimated $300K-$1M, 12-18 months.
5_prototype_blueprint.what_to_build_first: V1 engineering-only prototype. Validate pulsation sync mechanism. In parallel, engage enzyme engineering collaborator for items 01-04.
5_prototype_blueprint.estimated_build_time: 4-8 weeks V1 engineering-only. 6-12 months biology. 3-6 months V2 with enzyme. 12-24 months pre-clinical. 24-48 months clinical. 12-24 months PMA. Total: 5-10 years to market (single-enzyme path).

6_reference_implementation.rationale: Cannot build reference implementation for enzyme kinetics until enzyme identity and immobilization are resolved. Engineering portion (pulsation sync) can be simulated but requires CFD or bench validation.

7_experimental_protocol.test_1_engineering_validation: V1 bench prototype, non-enzymatic membrane. Validate pulsation sync hypothesis (1.3-1.5x tau enhancement) and drainage floor fail-safe. See P-04_FREEZE/EXTERNAL_VALIDATION_HANDOFF/.
7_experimental_protocol.test_2_enzyme_validation_BLOCKED: Requires V2 prototype with enzymatic membrane. Cannot run until items 01-04 resolved.
7_experimental_protocol.test_3_chronic_stability_BLOCKED: Requires 6-12 month in vitro test. Cannot start until item 04 resolved.

existing_evidence.evidence: ORIGINAL HYPOTHESIS. R277 freeze attempt found: BACE2 contested, tau-kinase 'inhibitor enzyme' chemically inconsistent, single-enzyme path recommended.

existing_evidence.claim: CSF Aβ << NEP Km (mass transport limited)
existing_evidence.evidence: Literature: CSF Aβ 0.1-0.2 nM, NEP Km 5-10 μM
existing_evidence.design_implication: Membrane geometry dominates clearance, not enzyme loading. Reverses original design intuition.

missing_evidence: Catalytic kinetics of immobilized enzyme in synthetic CSF
Pulsation sync validation (can be done with V1 engineering prototype)
8_validation_evidence.independent_validation_plan: Send P-04_FREEZE/EXTERNAL_VALIDATION_HANDOFF/ to external lab for V1 engineering-only validation. Full validation requires V2 with enzyme.

sensitivity_analysis.honest_label: MODELLED SCENARIO — NOT ECONOMIC PROOF. Highly speculative given biology is unfrozen.
sensitivity_analysis.base_case: If dual-function shunt clears 20% of Aβ → $10K-$40K/patient/year value. 10K patients = $100M-$400M/year.
sensitivity_analysis.critical_caveat: This entire model assumes the enzyme engineering program succeeds AND achieves clinically meaningful clearance. If biology fails, economic value = $0.

12_manufacturing_transfer_plan.materials: Enzyme-immobilized membrane (UNFROZEN), pulsation-synchronized valve (FROZEN, reuses P-01), flow sensor (FROZEN, reuses P-01)
12_manufacturing_transfer_plan.estimated_development_path: V1 engineering-only (1-2mo, $5-15K) → Enzyme engineering program (6-12mo, $300K-$1M) → V2 with enzyme (3-6mo) → Pre-clinical (24mo) → Clinical (36-60mo) → PMA (24mo). Total: 7-12 years.

hazards: Enzyme degradation → reduced clearance (not unsafe, just ineffective)
Flow restriction → impaired drainage (SAFETY CRITICAL — drainage floor 0.10 mL/min enforced by fail-safe bypass)
Enzyme release into CSF → immunological reaction (must be tested in item 04)
Biofilm formation on membrane → blocked drainage AND blocked enzyme activity
13_safety_package.safe_states: If enzyme fails → membrane becomes passive filter (drainage maintained, clearance lost). If valve fails → fail-open (drainage maintained, contact-time optimization lost). If Q < 0.10 mL/min → bypass enzyme entirely (fail-safe to standard shunt).

14_integration_package.how_it_plugs_in: Enzymatic membrane module + pulsation-synchronized valve controller integrated into existing shunt design.
14_integration_package.reuses_p_01_hardware: Flow sensor, variable orifice valve, MCU, telemetry — all from P-01.
